custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and click Board View in the display switcher.
  2. Type the name of {Customer-A} in Search.
  3. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card from {Technician-A}'s column into {Technician-B}'s column.
  4. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  5. Drag {Work-order-2}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  6. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column.
  7. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card into the Unassigned column.
  8. Drag {Work-order-3}'s card within {Technician-A}'s column to above {Work-order-1}.
  9. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card into {Technician-A}'s column.
  10. Drag {Work-order-4}'s card to a new place within the Unassigned column.
  11. Drag {Work-order-5}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  12. Drag {Work-order-6}'s card into {Technician-B}'s column (click Keep shifts if asked).
  13. Click {Work-order-2}'s card to open the work order.
  14. Try to change Lead Technician on the work order page.
  15. Go back to the Work Orders page.
  16. Click Tech View in the display switcher.
  17. Do steps 3 to 10 again with the rows.
  18. Drag {Work-order-5}'s row from {Technician-A}'s group into {Technician-B}'s group.
  19. Drag {Work-order-6}'s row from {Technician-B}'s group back into {Technician-A}'s group.
